name: anycubic-slicer-next-control
description: Secure local control of Anycubic Slicer Next on Windows through structured MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Safely prepare, export, and print local slicing jobs (LAN or cloud account).
interface.longDescription: Opens Anycubic Slicer Next, loads STL or 3MF models, applies validated basic settings, slices locally, exports G-code or G-code 3MF artifacts, inspects the desktop UI, and can upload/start/control prints on an Anycubic printer over LAN MQTT/FTP or via the user's Anycubic cloud account. It can also automatically capture the account access_token from the app's memory (watch mode) and store it DPAPI-encrypted for secure cloud printing.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Anycubic Slicer Next installation.
Prepare a safe slicing plan for this STL.
Discover my Anycubic printer and report its status.
Upload and start a print on my Anycubic printer.
Capture my Anycubic cloud token automatically and show my account printers.
List the printers in my Anycubic account.
